conventions.convention: Each ribbon double arc has exactly two disjoint source preimages: one properly embedded arc and one compact interior arc. There are finitely many disjoint double arcs and no other multiple points.

A no-maximum disk movie uses squared radial distance on a smooth proper disk in the standard four-ball, with only index-zero and index-one interior critical points and the exact radial boundary collar c_D(y,s)=(1-s)y.
The reverse mirror applies the fixed orientation-reversing ambient reflection and reverses the knot orientation.
The library's slice-genus definition assumes ACω; the local height-resolution construction itself is choice-free.
The trefoil counterexample assumes full AC, matching its published nonsliceness supplier; full AC supplies the ACω hypothesis of ribbon-implies-slice.

load_bearing.statement: A smooth immersion of an oriented disk into S³ with embedded boundary K and only finitely many pairwise disjoint transverse double arcs, each having one proper and one compact interior preimage arc, admits a smooth proper embedded resolution in B⁴ agreeing with the immersion on the boundary.

A ribbon disk is a smooth immersed oriented disk with embedded boundary and only finitely many disjoint transverse ribbon double arcs, each having one proper and one compact interior preimage arc, with no triple points or other self-intersections. A knot is ribbon if it admits such a disk.
Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. Every smooth oriented knot K in the standard oriented three-sphere has K#K† represented by the boundary of a ribbon immersion.

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. A smooth oriented knot K bounds a ribbon immersion in S³ if and only if it bounds a smooth properly embedded disk in the standard four-ball whose squared radial distance is Morse with only index-zero and index-one interior critical points and whose boundary collar is c_D(y,s)=(1-s)y.

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. Every smooth oriented knot K⊂S³ that bounds a smooth immersed disk in S³ with only ribbon double arcs bounds a smooth properly embedded disk in B⁴ with boundary K. In particular, its smooth slice genus is zero.
